meaning:
ὑπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑποστέλλω),
1. a letting down, lowering (Plut.).
2. a shrinking back (Hesych.): οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς (on the genitive, see Bl., § 35, 2), Heb.10:39.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
